manaNeeded: {9}{C}{C}{C} each turn plus {5} each turn beyond the first
description:
Cast Rise of the Eldrazi by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Rise of the Eldrazi
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Rise of the Eldrazi and up to six other exiled cards, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library. Ensure Rise of the Eldrazi is the top card of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Rise of the Eldrazi from your library during your draw step.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mirror of Fate from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Mirror of Fate from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.
